sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The "Birsa Harit Gram Yojana" by the Rural Development Department, Government of Jharkhand, promotes afforestation while generating sustainable livelihoods. It supports SC, ST, and landless families through plantation activities under MGNREGA, ensuring income and environmental sustainability.
**Who is this for:** Family; Category: Agriculture,Rural & Environment; Sector: Land and water resources

**Detailed Description:** The "Birsa Harit Gram Yojana" by the Rural Development Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to promote afforestation and provide sustainable livelihood opportunities for marginalized communities. Under this scheme, block and linear plantation activities are conducted on common and private lands, benefiting Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), landless families, and other economically weaker sections. The scheme is implemented by the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) framework.  ***Objective:*** The objectives include improving green cover, generating rural employment, and ensuring environmental sustainability through a structured three-phase plantation model.

**Benefits / Assistance:** 1. Plantation of fruit-bearing and fodder trees on common land and private land. 1. Sustainable livelihood generation for marginalized families. 1. Employment guarantee of 100 days under MGNREGA. 1. Usufruct rights over the plantation for beneficiaries.

**Application Process:** 1. The interested applicant may visit the local Gram Panchayat or MGNREGA office. 1. Submit a duly filled application form along with the required documents. 1. The Gram Sabha will verify and approve the eligible applications. 1. Upon approval, plantation work will be assigned as per the scheme phase.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act; Nodal Department: Rural Development Department
**Tags:** Financial Assistance, Livelihood, Opportunities, Promote Afforestation
